items.title: 彭博：中國已完成美國黃豆採購承諾一半目標
items.title_en: Bloomberg: China Has Fulfilled More Than Half of Its U.S. Soybean Purchase Commitment
paras: 據《彭博》14日（周一）報導，知情人士透露，中國已完成年度美國黃豆採購承諾的一半以上，國有貿易商上周至少預訂100萬噸美國黃豆，本季總採購量接近1,300萬噸，超過美方所稱北京承諾到2028年達成2,500萬噸年度目標的一半以上。
美國農業部數據顯示，最近一周美國黃豆裝運量加速至4月以來最高水準，而中國是最大出口目的地。
此外，農業部近日發布的9月報告中調高了黃豆產量和單產預估，出乎分析師此前預期下調的預料。
近期出口激增帶動黃豆價格漲至2023年以來最高水準，為美國農民在收獲季前夕帶來利多。與此同時，美國及其他地區生物燃料摻混比例提高，也增加了對國內加工的需求。
StoneX分析師邁克·卡斯爾在一份報告中表示，這些出口是「一個令人鼓舞的跡象，我們正朝著完成秋季不斷增長的銷售訂單邁進」。
Futures International LLC大宗商品銷售總監喬·戴維斯認為，採購需要持續才能維持這輪漲勢。由於美中兩國在人工智慧競爭等其他問題上的緊張關係，長期貿易前景依然不明朗。
中國買家重返市場，給美國黃豆出口帶來一場久違的反彈。而中國採購能否持續，是未來幾個月美國農民密切關注的關鍵問題。
美國農業網站「FarmProgress」11日報導，隨著中國從7月底開始積極採購美國新季黃豆，美國2026至2027銷售年度的黃豆出口訂單大幅增長。
在川普政府2025年挑起的貿易戰期間，中國曾連續約半年停止採購美國黃豆，轉而大量從巴西進口。去年美國在全球黃豆出口市場的市占率已降至22%，而十年前約40%。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Monday the 14th, sources said China has already completed more than half of its annual U.S. soybean purchase commitment, with state‑owned traders booking at least 1 million tonnes of U.S. soybeans last week and total purchases this quarter approaching 13 million tonnes, exceeding the U.S. claim that Beijing pledged to reach half of a 25 million‑ton annual target by 2028.

U.S. Department of Agriculture data show that soybean shipments from the United States accelerated to the highest level since April in the most recent week, with China remaining the largest export destination.
In addition, the USDA’s recent September report raised its forecasts for soybean output and yield, contrary to analysts’ earlier expectations of a downgrade.

The surge in exports has pushed soybean prices to their highest level since 2023, providing a boost to U.S. farmers ahead of the harvest season, while higher bio‑fuel blending ratios in the United States and elsewhere have also increased domestic processing demand.
StoneX analyst Mike Kessel said in a note that these exports are “an encouraging sign, and we are moving toward fulfilling a growing slate of fall sales orders.”

Joe Davis, senior commodity sales director at Futures International LLC, warned that continued purchasing is needed to sustain the current price rally, noting that lingering tensions between the U.S. and China over issues such as AI competition keep the long‑term trade outlook uncertain.

Chinese buyers have returned to the market, delivering a long‑awaited rebound for U.S. soybean exports, and whether Chinese procurement can be sustained will be a key question closely watched by American farmers in the coming months.
FarmProgress reported on the 11th that, as China began actively buying the new U.S. soybean crop at the end of July, export orders for the 2026‑27 marketing year jumped sharply.

During the trade war sparked by the Trump administration in 2025, China halted U.S. soybean purchases for about six months and shifted to large‑scale imports from Brazil; last year the United States’ share of the global soybean export market fell to 22%, down from roughly 40% a decade earlier.

items.title: 「搶鎢大戰」再起！海內外價差超百萬  中國出口管制下國內礦企業績轉換仍待驗證
items.title_en: "Tungsten Battle" Rekindles! Overseas‑Domestic Price Gap Exceeds One Million; Domestic Mining Firms' Performance Under China Export Controls Still Unproven
paras: 中國A股鎢相關族群周二(15日)再度衝高，翔鷺鎢業開盤一分鐘內觸及漲停，盤中最大封單超10億元(人民幣，下同)，終場漲9.06%報36.60元；中鎢高新漲5.17%至62.23元，章源鎢業漲5.73%至24.74%至62.23元，章源鎢業漲5.73%至24.74%至62.23元，章源鎢業漲5.73%至24.74元，廈門5.13元，主要因為在海外關鍵礦產政策連續加碼後，市場對鎢供給稀缺性的重新定價。
美國鎢商The Elmet周一(14日)宣布，已獲美國國防部4.5億美元投資，用於緬因、密西根州、俄亥俄等地鎢材產能，當日盤中飆漲約55%。美國商務部上月依據《國防生產法》禁止鎢廢料及電池黑粉出口一年。
與此同時，英國國家財富基金向Tungsten West注資最高7100萬英鎊，重啟德文郡Hemerdon鎢錫礦，目標2027年第一季逐步滿產。
非洲國家辛巴威繼5月將鎢列關鍵礦產後暫停所有形式鎢出口，越南工貿部提議將鎢剔除允許出口清單。
今年1月，中國商務部、海關總署加強對日兩用物項管制，禁止向日本軍事用戶、軍事用途出口。日本財務省數據顯示，今年前7月鎢材進口137.8噸、年減率41.1%，鎢酸鹽進口708.1噸、年減15%。

價格方面，根據中鎢在線周二數據，中國APT報價每噸59萬—60萬元，鎢粉約90萬元、碳化鎢粉約85萬元；歐洲APT報2900-3000美元/噸度(172.2萬—178.2萬人民幣)，較去年初漲價約794%。歐洲鎢鐵每公斤170—180美元(約79.9萬—84.6萬元人民幣)，較去年初漲約298%。中國國內與歐洲同指標噸價相差約112萬—119萬元，但價差不等於國內企業利潤：在出口許可、兩用物項審查、軍用最終用戶限制下，海外高價訂單能否放量，取決於配額、客戶資質與放行節奏。
供給方面，中國占主導，但受總量控制。根據美國USGS統計，去年中國鎢產量6.7萬噸，佔全球78.7%，中國國金證券則稱各方統計均指向今年中國鎢精礦產量將持續年減，海外僅巴庫塔、Sangdong、Dolphin等少數項目形成增量，短期彈性有限。
中國自然資源部每年下達鎢精礦開採總量，2025年首批指標5.8萬噸、年減6.45%，今年進一步降低、低品位礦區指標逐步清零。今年6月，《礦產資源法實施條例》將鎢列入戰略礦產。
根據中國國際礦業大會發布的《中國礦產資源報告2026》，截至「十四五」計畫末年，稀土、鎢、錫等14種礦產儲量居全球第一，但儲量優勢不等於短期可放量。
中鎢在線表示，供需雙方謹慎觀望，交投清淡，等待消費端備庫及下半月大型鎢企長單價；章源9月上半月55%黑鎢精礦長單每噸41.3萬元、白鎢41.2萬元略降。
今年中國APT報價曾由1月每噸約67萬元衝高至3月約152萬元，隨後回撤至9月約59.5萬元，基本抹平年內漲幅，65%黑鎢精礦3月高點約105萬元。硬質合金、PCB微鑽、六氟化鎢構成內需主線，其中六氟化鎢高純粉受中船特氣等半導體、AI氣體鏈關注，但下游以銷量定產量，主動補足庫存。
機構判斷「緊平衡」延續。國金、五礦證券均指出，全球新增鎢礦有限，逆全球化戰略儲備抬升需求，中國國內進口補缺空間受限，中期價格中樞可望上移；華安證券則把AI算力、關鍵礦產焦慮、供給偏緊列為本輪重估三因素。風險在於：中國APT報價若遲遲未脫離59萬—60萬元區間、長單價不上修，股價反彈易受制於業績兌現。此外，出口管制趨嚴雖支撐海外溢價，但也可能限制重量級企業銷售。
對鎢相關類股而言，專家認為後市須看三件事，分別為下半月大廠長單、硬質合金補庫、對日及歐美出口許可放行規模，三者決定「國外高價」能否真正變成中國國內利潤。
paras_en: China A‑share tungsten‑related stocks surged again on Tuesday (the 15th). Within the first minute, Xianglu Tungsten hit its daily limit up, with the largest order book exceeding RMB 1 billion, and closed up 9.06% at RMB 36.60. Zhongtong High‑Tech rose 5.17% to RMB 62.23, and Zhangyuan Tungsten climbed 5.73% to RMB 24.74. The rally was driven by renewed market pricing of tungsten scarcity after overseas key‑minerals policies were repeatedly tightened.

U.S. tungsten producer The Elmet announced on Monday (the 14th) that it had secured a $450 million investment from the U.S. Department of Defense for tungsten capacity in Maine, Michigan and Ohio, sending its shares soaring about 55% intraday. The U.S. Commerce Department last month prohibited the export of tungsten scrap and battery black powder for one year under the Defense Production Act.

At the same time, the UK’s National Wealth Fund pledged up to £71 million to Tungsten West to restart the Hemerdon tungsten‑tin mine in Devon, aiming for gradual full‑capacity production by the first quarter of 2027.

Zimbabwe, which listed tungsten as a critical mineral in May, has temporarily halted all forms of tungsten export, while Vietnam’s Ministry of Industry and Trade has proposed removing tungsten from its list of permitted export commodities.

In January, China’s Ministry of Commerce and General Administration of Customs tightened dual‑use controls, banning exports of tungsten materials to Japanese military users and for military purposes. Japanese Ministry of Finance data show that in the first seven months of this year tungsten imports fell 41.1% year‑on‑year to 137.8 tons, and tungsten salts fell 15% to 708.1 tons.

Pricing: according to Zhongtong Online data on Tuesday, China’s APT price was RMB 590,000‑600,000 per tonne, tungsten powder about RMB 900,000, and carbide‑tungsten powder about RMB 850,000. European APT was $2,900‑3,000 per tonne (RMB 1.722‑1.782 million), up roughly 794% since early last year. European tungsten‑iron fetched $170‑180 per kilogram (about RMB 799,000‑846,000), up about 298% since early last year. The domestic‑European price gap per tonne is roughly RMB 1.12‑1.19 million, but the gap does not equal domestic profit margins: high‑priced overseas orders depend on export licences, dual‑use reviews and end‑user restrictions, as well as quota availability, customer qualifications and clearance speed.

Supply: China remains dominant but production is capped. USGS data show China produced 67,000 tons of tungsten last year, 78.7% of global output. China Guojin Securities says all estimates point to a continued year‑on‑year decline in Chinese tungsten concentrate output this year, with only a few overseas projects such as Baku‑Ta, Sangdong and Dolphin adding incremental supply, leaving little short‑term flexibility.

The Ministry of Natural Resources issues annual tungsten concentrate production quotas; the first batch for 2025 is set at 58,000 tons with a 6.45% annual decline, and this year the quota is further reduced with low‑grade mine targets being phased out. In June, the Implementation Regulations of the Mineral Resources Law added tungsten to the list of strategic minerals.

According to the China Mining Resources Report 2026 released by the China International Mining Conference, by the end of the 14th Five‑Year Plan, China will still hold the world’s largest reserves of 14 minerals including rare earths, tungsten and tin, but reserve size does not guarantee short‑term production capacity.

Zhongtong Online notes that both supply and demand sides are watching cautiously, trading is light, and the market awaits inventory buildup on the consumer side and large‑order pricing from major tungsten firms in the second half of the month. Zhangyuan’s black‑tungsten concentrate long‑order price for the first half of September was RMB 413,000 per ton, slightly down from RMB 412,000 for white tungsten.

China’s APT price rose from about RMB 670,000 per ton in January to roughly RMB 1.52 million in March, then fell back to about RMB 595,000 in September, essentially erasing the intra‑year gain. Black‑tungsten concentrate peaked at about RMB 1.05 million in March (65% of the market). Domestic demand is driven by hard‑metal tools, PCB micro‑drilling and tungsten hexafluoride, with high‑purity WF6 powder attracting semiconductor and AI‑gas players such as CSIC Special Gases, while downstream production is tied to sales volumes, prompting proactive inventory replenishment.

Analysts judge that the “tight‑balance” will continue. Guojin and Wukuang Securities both point out that new global tungsten mines are scarce, and de‑globalisation‑driven strategic stockpiling lifts demand; China’s import gap is limited, so mid‑term price centres could rise. Huian Securities cites AI compute power, critical‑mineral anxiety and tight supply as the three factors driving the current re‑rating. Risks include APT prices lingering in the RMB 590,000‑600,000 band without long‑order price revisions, which could curb stock‑price rebounds if earnings fall short, and stricter export controls that, while supporting overseas premiums, may also limit sales by large firms.

For tungsten‑related equities, experts say the next move hinges on three things: large‑order pricing in the second half of the month, hard‑metal inventory replenishment, and the scale of export licences to Japan and Europe/US. These three will determine whether the “high overseas price” can truly translate into domestic profit.

items.title: 美光推全球首款512GB DDR5記憶體模組 預計2027下半年量產
items.title_en: Micron Announces World’s First 512GB DDR5 Memory Module, Plans Mass Production in Late 2027
paras: 美光 (MU-US) 在超高密度伺服器記憶體領域取得新進展，已成功在多款伺服器平台展示全球首款512GB DDR5 RDIMM，並預計於 2027 年下半年依客戶需求投入量產。
美光 (MU-US) 週二股價收漲0.39%，上漲3.57美元，收在每股927.60美元。盤中最高觸及944.94美元，最低下探920.13美元。
美光表示，這款512GB DDR5模組是公司產品開發的重要里程碑，鎖定人工智慧 (AI)、資料分析、記憶體內資料庫及模擬運算等高負載應用，傳輸速度最高可達9,200 MT/s。
AMD (AMD-US) 與英特爾 (INTC-US) 目前均在驗證這款模組，以確認其與下一代伺服器平台的相容性，並為後續部署與量產做好準備。
美光透過先進垂直互連封裝技術，利用矽穿孔 (TSV) 垂直堆疊並連接DRAM晶粒，在維持資料中心所需效能的同時，提高單一封裝的記憶體密度。
若搭載於具有24個記憶體插槽的雙路伺服器，整體DDR5記憶體容量最高可達12TB，讓更多資料直接留在主記憶體內，降低對速度較慢儲存設備的依賴及資料搬移成本。
在能源效率方面，單一512GB RDIMM的運作功耗，較4條128GB RDIMM組成的同容量配置降低逾60%，可在不擴大現有伺服器空間的情況下，提高記憶體容量、虛擬化密度及能源效率。
美光雲端記憶體事業部資深副總裁暨總經理Raj Narasimhan表示，512GB RDIMM能支援多TB級伺服器，滿足更大型的AI與資料庫工作負載，同時改善資源利用率。
效能測試顯示，在以Spark支援向量機 (SVM) 為基礎的記憶體受限型資料分析工作負載中，512GB RDIMM效能最高可達256GB DDR5配置的1.4倍。
新模組也適用於RocksDB、Redis等高度依賴記憶體的資料庫及快取平台，可提高資料處理量與並行作業能力，並支援更大規模的資料集。
美光指出，隨著大型語言模型 (LLM)、代理型AI、即時推論及高核心數CPU工作負載快速成長，市場對伺服器記憶體容量、頻寬及能源效率的需求持續升高。
AMD表示，正與美光合作整合運算與記憶體創新，以因應現代資料中心工作負載日益增加的規模與複雜度。英特爾也指出，記憶體容量與頻寬正成為影響伺服器整體效能的重要因素。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) has made a new breakthrough in ultra‑high‑density server memory, successfully demonstrating the world’s first 512GB DDR5 RDIMM on multiple server platforms and expects to begin volume production in the second half of 2027 based on customer demand.
Micron’s shares closed up 0.39% on Tuesday, rising $3.57 to $927.60 per share, with intraday highs of $944.94 and lows of $920.13.

Micron said the 512GB DDR5 module is a major product‑development milestone, targeting high‑load workloads such as artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics, in‑memory databases and simulation computing, with transfer speeds up to 9,200 MT/s.
AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) are currently validating the module to confirm compatibility with next‑generation server platforms and to prepare for subsequent deployment and mass production.

Micron uses advanced vertical interconnect packaging technology, employing silicon‑through‑via (TSV) vertical stacking and bonding of DRAM dies, which boosts memory density per package while maintaining the performance required by data centers.

When installed in a dual‑socket server with 24 memory slots, the total DDR5 memory capacity can reach up to 12 TB, allowing more data to stay directly in main memory, reducing reliance on slower storage and lowering data‑movement costs.

In terms of energy efficiency, a single 512GB RDIMM consumes over 60% less power than an equivalent capacity configuration built from four 128GB RDIMMs, enabling higher memory capacity, virtualization density and energy efficiency without expanding existing server space.

Raj Narasimhan, senior vice president and general manager of Micron’s Cloud Memory Business, said the 512GB RDIMM can support multi‑TB servers, meeting larger AI and database workloads while improving resource utilization.

Performance tests showed that for memory‑constrained data‑analytics workloads based on Spark‑supported support vector machines (SVM), the 512GB RDIMM delivers up to 1.4 times the performance of a 256GB DDR5 configuration.
The new module is also suitable for memory‑intensive databases and caching platforms such as RocksDB and Redis, increasing data throughput and parallelism and supporting larger data sets.

Micron noted that as large language models (LLM), agent‑based AI, real‑time inference and high‑core‑count CPU workloads grow rapidly, demand for server memory capacity, bandwidth and energy efficiency continues to rise.

AMD said it is working with Micron to integrate compute and memory innovations to meet the increasing scale and complexity of modern data‑center workloads, and Intel also highlighted that memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming key factors affecting overall server performance.

items.title: 原油破百、美債5%又怎樣！ 拆解利空真相：接下來怎麼做？
items.title_en: Oil Breaks $100, US 10‑Year Yields Near 5%—What’s the Real Bad News and What Should You Do Next?
paras: 原油一舉砸破100美元大關，10年期美債殖利率逼近5%的天花板，加上聯準會升息陰影籠罩下，很多人問江江：「是不是該把股票全賣了？新聞都在傳AI是不是要降溫了，再不逃會不會被套在山頂？」
高利率確實會殺本益比，但不是所有股票都一樣！先講最現實的。當美債殖利率往5%靠近，資金會重新計算風險報酬率。原本市場願意給高本益比的股票，估值自然會受到壓縮。
尤其是那些「現在沒賺多少錢，未來全靠故事」的題材股，壓力最大。但真正有意思的是另一邊。如果一家公司的營收、EPS還在高速成長，那麼就算本益比被壓縮，獲利成長仍可能抵銷部分估值壓力。
這就是為什麼現在不能看到AI股跌，就把所有AI相關股票一網打盡。高利率環境不是不能買股票，而是你要從「買故事」升級成「買獲利」。
AI真的降溫了嗎？別被新聞帶著走了
最近最讓投資人害怕的另一個問題，就是AI投資降溫。市場開始傳出AI模型開發放慢、資安疑慮升高、科技巨頭可能調整資本支出。聽起來很嚇人。
但你真正應該看的，是企業有沒有開始砍資本支出、AI伺服器訂單有沒有明顯縮減，以及未來獲利預期是否大幅下修。目前看到的產業數據，反而沒有那麼悲觀。
台積電（2330-TW）8月營收首度突破5,000億元，年增53.3%；公司也表示AI需求仍處於長期成長初期，CoWoS先進封裝產能依舊吃緊。更關鍵的是，台積電CoWoS供給甚至還跟不上AI需求，訂單開始外溢到日月光投控（3711-TW）等其他封裝供應鏈。這和「AI需求突然消失」是兩回事。
再看廣達（2382-TW）：8月營收直接衝上4,239億元，年增177%，創下單月歷史新高；公司目前AI伺服器訂單能見度已看到2027年，甚至開始看到2028年的需求。所以市場現在真正需要分辨的是：AI泡沫股在修正，還是AI產業真的反轉？目前比較像前者。
如果台股拉回，哪些股票值得放進觀察名單？

High interest rates do indeed crush price‑to‑earnings multiples, but not every stock is affected the same way. Here’s the most practical view: as Treasury yields approach 5%, investors will re‑calculate risk‑adjusted returns. Stocks that previously commanded lofty multiples will naturally see their valuations compressed.

items.title: 投資人主動送錢！OpenAI傳洽談新募資 估值衝上1.2兆美元大增41%
items.title_en: Investors Take the Initiative! OpenAI Said to Discuss New Funding Round, Valuation Jumps 41% to $1.2 Trillion
paras: 英國《金融時報》(FT)周二(15日)引述知情人士說法報導，OpenAI近期已與大型投資人討論新一輪募資，將使這家ChatGPT開發商在上市前的估值提高至約1.2兆美元。

投資人主動接洽 募資討論仍處早期

根據報導，OpenAI與投資人的接觸還在初步階段，1.2兆美元的估值未來幾個月仍可能改變。值得注意的是，有關募資的討論是由投資人主動發起，而非OpenAI主動尋求。
OpenAI今年3月才完成最近期一輪募資，當時獲得1220億美元承諾資金，估值達8520億美元。
若以1.2兆美元估值計算，較3月那一輪募資時的8520億美元估值高出約41%。

2026年不上市 AI風險成焦點

OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)上周六證實，OpenAI今年不會上市，以優先考量人工智慧(AI)發展風險。
界對AI的安全性及遭濫用的疑慮持續升高之際，OpenAI與競爭對手Anthropic近日都呼籲加強AI監管。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)上周六發表一篇3800字文章，文中呼籲政府對AI進行監管，並主張放慢最先進AI系統的開發速度，讓研究人員有更多時間了解潛在威脅。這篇文章很快獲得OpenAI的奧特曼及SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克支持，但美國總統川普卻強烈反彈，把對AI風險的擔憂斥為「騙局」，並反對制定新規範。
而據路透本月稍早報導，Anthropic最快預定10月中旬開始推銷首次公開發行(IPO)，擬於11月美國期中選舉前幾天完成上市。
paras_en: The Financial Times (FT) in the UK reported on Tuesday (the 15th) that, according to sources, OpenAI has recently been in talks with large investors about a new funding round that would lift the ChatGPT developer’s pre‑IPO valuation to roughly $1.2 trillion.

Investor‑initiated talks are still in the early stage, and the $1.2 trillion valuation could still change over the next few months. Notably, the fundraising discussion was sparked by investors rather than by OpenAI itself.
OpenAI only completed its most recent financing in March of this year, when it secured $122 billion in committed capital and was valued at $852 billion.
Using the $1.2 trillion figure, the valuation is about 41% higher than the $852 billion valuation from the March round.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed last Saturday that the company will not go public this year, prioritising the risks associated with artificial‑intelligence development.
As concerns over AI safety and misuse continue to rise, both OpenAI and rival Anthropic have recently called for stronger AI regulation.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a 3,800‑word essay last Saturday urging governments to regulate AI and to slow the development of the most advanced systems so researchers have more time to understand potential threats. The piece quickly drew support from OpenAI’s Altman and SpaceX AI chief Elon Musk, while former U.S. President Trump reacted strongly, dismissing AI‑risk worries as a "scam" and opposing new rules.

According to a Reuters report earlier this month, Anthropic plans to begin marketing its initial public offering as early as mid‑October, aiming to complete the listing a few days before the U.S. midterm elections in November.

items.title: 美國消費韌性背後：加薪與通膨陷入拉鋸戰 而通膨正在勝出
items.title_en: The Resilience of U.S. Consumption: Wage Growth and Inflation in a Tug-of-War, with Inflation Winning
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，物價上漲正在侵蝕一般薪資的購買力。
美國8月平均時薪有所下降，同時消費者物價指數(CPI)的漲幅高於平均時薪的成長幅度。
經過通膨調整後的薪資，即所謂的「實質薪資」，自2月以來一直呈現下降趨勢，目前已略低於2025年5月的水準。2月至8月期間，實質薪資下跌了0.7%。
這次通膨調整後，也就是「實質」薪資下降，很大程度上是受到燃料價格上漲所造成。
雖然這次的降幅不像疫情後那幾年那麼嚴重，但對家庭預算而言，仍代表一次退步。
這也對整體經濟構成風險，因為美國經濟目前越來越依賴股市上漲所帶來的財富效應來支撐消費支出。
由於68%的GDP來自消費支出，如果人們開始縮減家庭預算，以因應食品、汽油等生活必需品價格上漲，經濟成長可能會受到打擊。
勞工購買力下降會削弱消費者信心，如果民眾因此減少消費，也會對整體經濟帶來風險。
Oxford Economics資深經濟學家Bob Schwartz在一篇評論中寫道，「很明顯，今年消費支出的韌性，與其說是受到勞工薪資支撐，不如說更多是來自大量的退稅、消耗存款，以及股市熱度所帶來的財富效應。」
由於目前有相當大一部分的消費支出，是由富裕家庭所帶動，而這些家庭的財務狀況受惠於AI擴張所推動的股市繁榮，因此相較於平常，整體經濟現在對AI產業一旦出現下滑變得更加脆弱。
如果聯準會(Fed)升息，或者社會對AI技術的反彈情緒阻礙資料中心建設，目前支撐股市的這波AI支出熱潮都可能失去動能。
Schwartz寫道，「雖然這些事件發生的可能性不能忽視，但我們並不預期它們會在可預見的未來拖垮整體經濟。然而，很難忽視那些與各種外部衝擊，以及勞工影響力逐漸減弱相關的警訊。」
paras_en: Investopedia reports that rising prices are eroding the purchasing power of ordinary wages.
U.S. average hourly wages fell in August, while the consumer price index (CPI) increased at a faster pace than the growth in average hourly wages.

After adjusting for inflation, the so‑called "real wages" have been on a downward trend since February and are now slightly below the level of May 2025. Between February and August, real wages fell by 0.7%.
The decline in real wages is largely driven by higher fuel prices.
Although the decline is not as severe as in the years following the pandemic, it still represents a setback for household budgets.
This poses a risk to the overall economy because the U.S. economy increasingly relies on the wealth effect from stock market gains to support consumer spending.
Since 68% of GDP comes from consumer spending, if people start cutting household budgets to cope with rising prices for essentials such as food and gasoline, economic growth could be hit.
A decline in labor purchasing power weakens consumer confidence, and if people reduce spending as a result, it poses a risk to the overall economy.

Senior economist Bob Schwartz of Oxford Economics wrote in a commentary that "it is clear that this year’s resilience of consumer spending is less about labor wage support and more about large tax refunds, depletion of savings, and the wealth effect from stock market enthusiasm."

Because a substantial portion of consumer spending is driven by affluent households whose financial positions benefit from the stock market boom fueled by AI expansion, the overall economy is now more vulnerable to a downturn in the AI sector than usual.
If the Fed raises rates or public sentiment against AI technology hampers data center construction, the current AI‑driven spending wave that supports the stock market could lose momentum.

Schwartz wrote that "while the probability of these events cannot be ignored, we do not expect them to collapse the overall economy in the foreseeable future. However, it is difficult to ignore the warning signs associated with various external shocks and the gradual weakening of labor influence."

items.title: 加密貨幣法案闖關美國參議院失敗！比特幣跌超5%創六月來最大跌幅 以太幣崩逾8.3%
paras: 美國《數位資產市場清晰法案》(Clarity Act)周二(15日)在參議院投票未獲得足夠支持，導致推進受阻。受此消息影響，比特幣和以太幣價格應聲大跌，創6月來單日最大跌幅紀錄。
在周二的關鍵程序性投票中，該法案以49票贊成、50票反對的結果，未能達到參議院推進法案所需的60票門檻。
《清晰法案》主要賦予美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)監管數位資產產業的主要權力，並為加密貨幣交易平台，以及現貨交易建立更明確的聯邦監管框架。
該法案的爭議點之一為，增加一項針對美國財政部的「熔斷機制」，允許其禁止加密貨幣企業向穩定幣用戶提供獎勵、利息或收益，這也是數位資產行業與傳統銀行業之間的一個主要爭執。
法案投票失敗的消息迅速傳導至加密貨幣市場，引發大幅拋售，比特幣價格一度下跌5.3%，失守75000美元大關，最低觸及 74910 美元，創6月以來最大跌幅，以太幣跌幅則更重，一度大跌超過8.3%

items.title: 喊話放慢AI腳步引爆川普反彈！Anthropic高層傳會晤美官員 化解安全風險
paras: Anthropic與川普政府因為人工智慧(AI)開發問題關係再度緊張之際，川普政府高階官員周二(15日)與該公司高層主管會面，討論AI的安全風險。
美媒引述知情人士說法報導，已成為Anthropic在華府主要代表的運算長Tom Brown，當天以視訊方式與美國國防部首席技術官Emil Michael及商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)進行會談。

CEO主張放慢AI開發 川普強烈反對

Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)上周六發表一篇3 800字文章，讓該公司與川普政府之間的關係再度緊張。
阿莫戴在文中呼籲政府對AI進行監管，並主張放慢最先進AI系統的開發速度，讓研究人員有更多時間了解潛在威脅。這篇文章很快獲得競爭對手OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)及SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克支持，但美國總統川普卻強烈反彈，把對AI風險的擔憂斥為「騙局」，並反對制定新規範。
Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon上周高調離職，並在社群媒體發布辭職信指責AI公司正在「拿我們的生命冒險」、「AI可能很快毀滅人類」，使先進AI模型的潛在風險在過去一周逐漸成為主流議題。
在川普政府內部，Emil Michael負責五角大廈加速採用AI的工作，他曾公開反駁Coxon所謂AI可能導致全人類死亡的說法。另據知情人士透露，盧特尼克希望在11月期中選舉前，反擊外界對AI技術的負面論述。

Anthropic與美政府關係仍緊張

Anthropic與美國政府的關係已因多項爭議而陷入緊張，例如旗下最先進的Mythos與Fable AI模型因安全問題美國商務部產生分歧，也曾與五角大廈為了AI用於軍事行動一事發生爭執。
Michael曾協助主導Anthropic與美政府有關軍方使用AI技術的談判，但雙方最終談判失敗，原因是五角大廈認為Anthropic提出的條件侵害軍方權限。五角大廈隨後將Anthropic列入黑名單，宣稱該公司對美國供應鏈構成威脅，Anthropic則針對此事對五角大廈提起訴訟，目前案件仍在華府法院進行中。
Brown則是在今年夏初開始受到華府關注，他當時主導與美國官員的高風險談判，爭取解除針對Anthropic最先進AI模型所實施的出口管制。他最終成功完成這項任務，並在本月稍早舉行的科技主題G20峰會上與盧特尼克一同公開露面，當時還特別稱讚川普對資料中心的支持。
Brown如今可能又將面臨另一項棘手挑戰：如何緩解Anthropic與美國官員在AI安全問題上的緊張關係。川普周一在Truth Social發文表示，他的總統任期本身就是AI唯一需要的安全護欄，而且還說，要放慢AI發展是個糟糕的想法，只會讓中國等美國對手受益。

items.title: 原油破百、美債5%又怎樣！ 拆解利空真相：接下來怎麼做？
items.title_en: Oil Breaks $100, US 10‑Year Yields Near 5%—What’s the Real Bad News and What Should You Do Next?
paras: 原油一舉砸破100美元大關，10年期美債殖利率逼近5%的天花板，加上聯準會升息陰影籠罩下，很多人問江江：「是不是該把股票全賣了？新聞都在傳AI是不是要降溫了，再不逃會不會被套在山頂？」
高利率確實會殺本益比，但不是所有股票都一樣！先講最現實的。當美債殖利率往5%靠近，資金會重新計算風險報酬率。原本市場願意給高本益比的股票，估值自然會受到壓縮。
尤其是那些「現在沒賺多少錢，未來全靠故事」的題材股，壓力最大。但真正有意思的是另一邊。如果一家公司的營收、EPS還在高速成長，那麼就算本益比被壓縮，獲利成長仍可能抵銷部分估值壓力。
這就是為什麼現在不能看到AI股跌，就把所有AI相關股票一網打盡。高利率環境不是不能買股票，而是你要從「買故事」升級成「買獲利」。
AI真的降溫了嗎？別被新聞帶著走了
最近最讓投資人害怕的另一個問題，就是AI投資降溫。市場開始傳出AI模型開發放慢、資安疑慮升高、科技巨頭可能調整資本支出。聽起來很嚇人。
但你真正應該看的，是企業有沒有開始砍資本支出、AI伺服器訂單有沒有明顯縮減，以及未來獲利預期是否大幅下修。目前看到的產業數據，反而沒有那麼悲觀。

With the Fed’s rate‑hike shadow looming, many people ask Jiang Jiang: “Should I sell all my stocks? The news keeps saying AI might be cooling off—if I don’t get out now will I be stuck at the top?”

High interest rates do indeed crush price‑to‑earnings multiples, but not every stock is affected the same way. Here’s the most practical view: as Treasury yields approach 5%, investors will re‑calculate risk‑adjusted returns. Stocks that previously commanded lofty multiples will naturally see their valuations compressed.

The pressure is greatest on “story‑driven” stocks that aren’t earning much now and rely entirely on future hype. The more interesting side is the opposite case: if a company’s revenue and EPS are still growing rapidly, a lower multiple can be offset by strong earnings growth, easing some of the valuation pressure.

That’s why you can’t just see AI stocks staying flat and then wipe out every AI‑related holding. A high‑rate environment doesn’t mean you can’t buy stocks; it means you need to shift from “buying stories” to “buying profits.”
Is AI Really Cooling Off? Don’t Let the Headlines Lead You.

The other fear gripping investors lately is a slowdown in AI investment. Rumors are circulating that AI model development is slowing, cybersecurity concerns are rising, and tech giants may trim capital expenditures. It sounds scary.

What you should actually look at is whether companies are cutting capex, whether AI server orders are visibly shrinking, and whether future profit forecasts are being sharply downgraded. The industry data we’ve seen so far is actually less bleak than the headlines suggest.

TSMC (2330‑TW) posted August revenue that broke the NT$5 trillion mark for the first time, up 53.3% year‑over‑year. The company also said AI demand is still in the early stage of long‑term growth, and CoWoS advanced‑packaging capacity remains tight. More importantly, TSMC’s CoWoS supply is even lagging behind AI demand, with orders spilling over to other packaging players such as ASE Technology (3711‑TW). That’s a far cry from “AI demand suddenly disappearing.”

Look at Quanta Computer (2382‑TW): August revenue jumped to NT$423.9 billion, a 177% year‑over‑year increase and a record high for a single month. The firm already sees AI server order visibility out to 2027 and even glimpses demand for 2028. So the market now needs to distinguish whether AI‑bubble stocks are correcting or the AI industry is truly reversing. The evidence points more toward the former.
If the Taiwan market pulls back, which stocks deserve a spot on your watch list?
TSMC (2330‑TW)

August revenue broke the NT$5 trillion barrier, with 2‑nm and CoWoS demand staying robust; dual growth in advanced processes and advanced packaging makes it one of the few AI‑core stocks with real profit support in a high‑rate environment.
Quanta Computer (2382‑TW)
August revenue of NT$423.971 billion, up 177.45% YoY; AI server shipments are the main growth engine, with order visibility extending to 2027 and even 2028, keeping operational momentum strong.
Chih Hsing (3017‑TW)

August revenue of NT$19.481 billion, up 54.34% YoY and 76.1% for the first eight months; AI server power consumption is rising, driving demand for water‑cooling, CDU and ASIC thermal solutions, and the company plans a large capacity expansion next year.
Unimicron (3037‑TW)

August revenue of NT$17.746 billion, up 56.26% YoY, marking a fifth‑straight‑month record high; AI is boosting demand for high‑end ABF substrates, with larger size, more layers and greater complexity, keeping substrate supply tight.
Lian Ya (3081‑TWO)

August revenue of NT$520 million, up 180.9% YoY and 129% for the first eight months; booming high‑speed optical‑communication demand makes it a key beneficiary of AI data‑center interconnect upgrades, though its valuation and volatility are noticeably higher.
MediaTek (2454‑TW)

August revenue of NT$64.183 billion, up 44.08% YoY; beyond smartphone chips, AI ASICs, edge computing and high‑performance computing provide a second growth curve, and if market panic forces a valuation correction, the stock becomes worth watching.

XINHUA (5274‑TW): Recently signed a two‑year capacity‑purchase agreement with upstream packaging firm ASE Technology (3711‑TW), proving that server orders are so abundant they must secure capacity in advance. The fundamentals show strong scarcity and long‑term growth explosive power.

Conclusion: Ruthlessly cut pure‑story stocks with no revenue, no profit, and institutional investors continuously pulling out. Lock onto the strong‑hand stocks that exhibit “record revenue + profit growth + institutional ownership.” When the next Taiwan market breakout appears and the MACD turns red‑to‑green, that’s the launch pad for these truly profitable stocks to surge.

paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 摩根士丹利Morgan Stanley(MS-US)認為，亞洲股票市場仍存在長期成長機會，其中台灣憑藉科技產業的重要地位，已深度融入全球科技股投資主題。
摩根士丹利共同總裁Daniel Simkowitz在Barclays Global Financial Services Conference表示，亞洲股票市場正在展現更廣泛的活力，日本市場相較5至6年前明顯復甦，韓國市場也重新受到關注，而台灣則「深度融入科技股交易（embedded in the technology trade）」。
Simkowitz指出，大中華區市場正積極尋求經濟成長動能，國際投資人也希望參與亞洲市場機會，印度同樣具備後續發展潛力。從摩根士丹利的布局來看，日本、韓國、台灣、大中華區及印度，都是亞洲股票市場長期發展的重要區塊。
摩根士丹利並認為，目前AI投資週期仍處於相對早期至中期階段。公司觀察到AI基礎建設仍存在龐大需求，相關資本支出尚處早期，且股權與信用市場都將參與AI基礎建設融資。從全球科技投資週期延續的角度來看，這也使深度參與科技產業的台灣市場持續具有觀察價值。

Viewed in the context of the ongoing global tech investment cycle, this keeps Taiwan’s market, which is deeply involved in the tech industry, of continued interest.

paras_en: Pre‑market news for Taiwan stocks on September 16.

On the 15th, Taiwan’s stock market volume hit the second‑lowest level of the year, and the 46,000‑point threshold was briefly reclaimed then lost, closing at 45,511 points, down 351 points, testing the seasonal‑line support. All three major institutional investors were net sellers, indicating relatively low willingness to hold shares. Foreign investors targeted second‑tier wafer‑foundries for withdrawals, net‑selling a total of 95,000 contracts of TSMC and UMC, and simultaneously rebalanced active‑style, index‑type and high‑dividend ETFs – five of the top‑ten net‑selling stocks were ETFs, amounting to a total adjustment of 186,000 contracts.

On September 16 the market will host a heavyweight dividend‑ex‑date event. The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced that three weighted‑index component stocks – TSMC (2330‑TW), Material‑KY (4763‑TW) and Lichi (1517‑TW) – will undergo dividend‑ex‑date trading on that day. The dividend payouts will reduce the market‑capitalisation‑weighted index by an estimated 56.59 points, with TSMC alone accounting for about 55.64 points of the decline.

TSMC’s Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Mi Yu‑chie held a dialogue with National Taiwan University students on the 15th, discussing the development and risks of artificial intelligence (AI). He described current AI as “like a three‑year‑old Superman” – extremely powerful but also capable of producing unknown outcomes. Recent warnings from CEOs of AI firms such as Anthropic and OpenAI have reinforced TSMC’s cautious stance on using AI tools for sensitive R&D information.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) officially launched its next‑generation flagship mobile chipset series, the Dimensity 9600, on the 15th. The top‑end Dimensity 9600 Pro uses TSMC’s 2‑nm process for the first time and incorporates a full‑big‑core CPU and a native AI architecture, marking MediaTek’s entry into the 2‑nm era. Apple recently announced its 2‑nm A20 Pro chip for the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro series, so the two major smartphone‑chip camps will now face off directly at 2 nm. Phones equipped with MediaTek’s new chip could be on sale in Taiwan as early as October.

Thirteen listed financial holding companies disclosed their full‑year‑2026 earnings for August. Benefiting from the Taiwan market rebound, strong AI‑related stocks and active capital‑market trading, the holdings saw a profit surge. The combined after‑tax net profit for the month reached NT$86.126 billion; cumulative after‑tax profit for the first eight months surpassed NT$570 billion, climbing to NT$578.907 billion – a year‑over‑year increase of nearly 60% and a record high for the same period. Fubon Financial (2881‑TW) reclaimed the title of highest monthly profit, and its cumulative profit and EPS remain the best among holdings. Five firms – Taishin‑Shinkong (2887‑TW), Yuanta (2885‑TW), KGI (2883‑TW), Yongfeng (2890‑TW) and Guo Piao (2889‑TW) – each earned more this year than they did in the entire previous year.

U.S. Treasury yields broke the 5% mark and the U.S. dollar index kept strengthening, deepening market expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Ahead of major central‑bank rate decisions, hedge‑fund sentiment surged, and Asian equities were broadly weak on the 15th. Taiwan’s market also suffered a “stock‑and‑currency double‑kill”: the New Taiwan dollar fell more than 0.20 NTD against the U.S. dollar, closing at 31.848 NTD, down 0.16 NTD, marking a fourth consecutive depreciation, the largest single‑day drop in over six months and the lowest level in nearly three weeks.

The Ministry of Finance announced on the 15th the final anti‑dumping investigation results for cold‑rolled non‑grain-oriented electrical steel imported from South Korea and mainland China. Both countries’ exporters were found to be dumping. The Korean firms showed the highest dumping margin at 59.35%, while Chinese firms recorded a margin of 26.44%. Customs has been instructed to levy provisional anti‑dumping duties based on these final margins, and the case has been forwarded to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for a final determination of national economic interest and industry damage. A decision on the formal duty rate is expected within 50 days.
46,000 points cannot be reclaimed; foreign investors sold NT$227.2 billion over four days, withdrawing a total of 95,000 contracts of TSMC and UMC.
NTD‑linked “stock‑and‑currency double‑kill”: the central bank’s pre‑week‑end panic led to a 0.16 NTD drop, the biggest depreciation in nearly six months.

Thirteen financial holdings posted a combined NT$578.9 billion profit for the first eight months, a new high; Fubon Financial returned to the triple‑crown; five firms out‑earned the entire previous year.
MediaTek’s 2‑nm Dimensity 9600 Pro unveiled, set to challenge Apple’s A20; phones could launch as early as October.
Mi Yu‑chie responded to AI giants: “AI is like a three‑year‑old Superman – very powerful but may also bring unknown results.”
Three stocks including TSMC will have dividend‑ex‑date on September 16; the index is expected to lose more than 56 points.
Strong August: Fubon Financial earned NT$120.2 billion in the first eight months, affecting retained earnings by NT$233.68 billion – a record impact.
The finance ministry approved anti‑dumping duties on South Korean and Chinese electrical steel, with the highest provisional duty reaching 59%.
Ye Jun‑hsian estimates Taiwan’s GDP could reach 12% this year, with mild inflation akin to a normal body temperature becoming the new norm.

items.title: 美光推全球首款512GB DDR5記憶體模組 預計2027下半年量產
items.title_en: Micron Announces World’s First 512GB DDR5 Memory Module, Plans Mass Production in Late 2027
paras: 美光 (MU-US) 在超高密度伺服器記憶體領域取得新進展，已成功在多款伺服器平台展示全球首款512GB DDR5 RDIMM，並預計於 2027 年下半年依客戶需求投入量產。
美光 (MU-US) 週二股價收漲0.39%，上漲3.57美元，收在每股927.60美元。盤中最高觸及944.94美元，最低下探920.13美元。
美光表示，這款512GB DDR5模組是公司產品開發的重要里程碑，鎖定人工智慧 (AI)、資料分析、記憶體內資料庫及模擬運算等高負載應用，傳輸速度最高可達9,200 MT/s。
AMD (AMD-US) 與英特爾 (INTC-US) 目前均在驗證這款模組，以確認其與下一代伺服器平台的相容性，並為後續部署與量產做好準備。
美光透過先進垂直互連封裝技術，利用矽穿孔 (TSV) 垂直堆疊並連接DRAM晶粒，在維持資料中心所需效能的同時，提高單一封裝的記憶體密度。
若搭載於具有24個記憶體插槽的雙路伺服器，整體DDR5記憶體容量最高可達12TB，讓更多資料直接留在主記憶體內，降低對速度較慢儲存設備的依賴及資料搬移成本。
在能源效率方面，單一512GB RDIMM的運作功耗，較4條128GB RDIMM組成的同容量配置降低逾60%，可在不擴大現有伺服器空間的情況下，提高記憶體容量、虛擬化密度及能源效率。
美光雲端記憶體事業部資深副總裁暨總經理Raj Narasimhan表示，512GB RDIMM能支援多TB級伺服器，滿足更大型的AI與資料庫工作負載，同時改善資源利用率。
效能測試顯示，在以Spark支援向量機 (SVM) 為基礎的記憶體受限型資料分析工作負載中，512GB RDIMM效能最高可達256GB DDR5配置的1.4倍。
新模組也適用於RocksDB、Redis等高度依賴記憶體的資料庫及快取平台，可提高資料處理量與並行作業能力，並支援更大規模的資料集。
美光指出，隨著大型語言模型 (LLM)、代理型AI、即時推論及高核心數CPU工作負載快速成長，市場對伺服器記憶體容量、頻寬及能源效率的需求持續升高。
AMD表示，正與美光合作整合運算與記憶體創新，以因應現代資料中心工作負載日益增加的規模與複雜度。英特爾也指出，記憶體容量與頻寬正成為影響伺服器整體效能的重要因素。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) has made a new breakthrough in ultra‑high‑density server memory, successfully demonstrating the world’s first 512GB DDR5 RDIMM on multiple server platforms and expects to begin volume production in the second half of 2027 based on customer demand.
Micron’s shares closed up 0.39% on Tuesday, rising $3.57 to $927.60 per share, with intraday highs of $944.94 and lows of $920.13.

Micron said the 512GB DDR5 module is a major product‑development milestone, targeting high‑load workloads such as artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics, in‑memory databases and simulation computing, with transfer speeds up to 9,200 MT/s.
AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) are currently validating the module to confirm compatibility with next‑generation server platforms and to prepare for subsequent deployment and mass production.

Micron uses advanced vertical interconnect packaging technology, employing silicon‑through‑via (TSV) vertical stacking and bonding of DRAM dies, which boosts memory density per package while maintaining the performance required by data centers.

When installed in a dual‑socket server with 24 memory slots, the total DDR5 memory capacity can reach up to 12 TB, allowing more data to stay directly in main memory, reducing reliance on slower storage and lowering data‑movement costs.

In terms of energy efficiency, a single 512GB RDIMM consumes over 60% less power than an equivalent capacity configuration built from four 128GB RDIMMs, enabling higher memory capacity, virtualization density and energy efficiency without expanding existing server space.

Raj Narasimhan, senior vice president and general manager of Micron’s Cloud Memory Business, said the 512GB RDIMM can support multi‑TB servers, meeting larger AI and database workloads while improving resource utilization.

Performance tests showed that for memory‑constrained data‑analytics workloads based on Spark‑supported support vector machines (SVM), the 512GB RDIMM delivers up to 1.4 times the performance of a 256GB DDR5 configuration.
The new module is also suitable for memory‑intensive databases and caching platforms such as RocksDB and Redis, increasing data throughput and parallelism and supporting larger data sets.

Micron noted that as large language models (LLM), agent‑based AI, real‑time inference and high‑core‑count CPU workloads grow rapidly, demand for server memory capacity, bandwidth and energy efficiency continues to rise.

AMD said it is working with Micron to integrate compute and memory innovations to meet the increasing scale and complexity of modern data‑center workloads, and Intel also highlighted that memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming key factors affecting overall server performance.

items.title: 投資人主動送錢！OpenAI傳洽談新募資 估值衝上1.2兆美元大增41%
items.title_en: Investors Take the Initiative! OpenAI Said to Discuss New Funding Round, Valuation Jumps 41% to $1.2 Trillion
paras: 英國《金融時報》(FT)周二(15日)引述知情人士說法報導，OpenAI近期已與大型投資人討論新一輪募資，將使這家ChatGPT開發商在上市前的估值提高至約1.2兆美元。

投資人主動接洽 募資討論仍處早期

根據報導，OpenAI與投資人的接觸還在初步階段，1.2兆美元的估值未來幾個月仍可能改變。值得注意的是，有關募資的討論是由投資人主動發起，而非OpenAI主動尋求。
OpenAI今年3月才完成最近期一輪募資，當時獲得1220億美元承諾資金，估值達8520億美元。
若以1.2兆美元估值計算，較3月那一輪募資時的8520億美元估值高出約41%。

2026年不上市 AI風險成焦點

OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)上周六證實，OpenAI今年不會上市，以優先考量人工智慧(AI)發展風險。
界對AI的安全性及遭濫用的疑慮持續升高之際，OpenAI與競爭對手Anthropic近日都呼籲加強AI監管。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)上周六發表一篇3800字文章，文中呼籲政府對AI進行監管，並主張放慢最先進AI系統的開發速度，讓研究人員有更多時間了解潛在威脅。這篇文章很快獲得OpenAI的奧特曼及SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克支持，但美國總統川普卻強烈反彈，把對AI風險的擔憂斥為「騙局」，並反對制定新規範。
而據路透本月稍早報導，Anthropic最快預定10月中旬開始推銷首次公開發行(IPO)，擬於11月美國期中選舉前幾天完成上市。
paras_en: The Financial Times (FT) in the UK reported on Tuesday (the 15th) that, according to sources, OpenAI has recently been in talks with large investors about a new funding round that would lift the ChatGPT developer’s pre‑IPO valuation to roughly $1.2 trillion.

Investor‑initiated talks are still in the early stage, and the $1.2 trillion valuation could still change over the next few months. Notably, the fundraising discussion was sparked by investors rather than by OpenAI itself.
OpenAI only completed its most recent financing in March of this year, when it secured $122 billion in committed capital and was valued at $852 billion.
Using the $1.2 trillion figure, the valuation is about 41% higher than the $852 billion valuation from the March round.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed last Saturday that the company will not go public this year, prioritising the risks associated with artificial‑intelligence development.
As concerns over AI safety and misuse continue to rise, both OpenAI and rival Anthropic have recently called for stronger AI regulation.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a 3,800‑word essay last Saturday urging governments to regulate AI and to slow the development of the most advanced systems so researchers have more time to understand potential threats. The piece quickly drew support from OpenAI’s Altman and SpaceX AI chief Elon Musk, while former U.S. President Trump reacted strongly, dismissing AI‑risk worries as a "scam" and opposing new rules.

According to a Reuters report earlier this month, Anthropic plans to begin marketing its initial public offering as early as mid‑October, aiming to complete the listing a few days before the U.S. midterm elections in November.

paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週二全面收黑，能源價格再度攀升，加上美國10年期公債殖利率突破5%心理關卡，市場對通膨與利率前景的擔憂升高。投資人並等待聯準會週三公布利率決策，使盤面風險偏好降溫。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – U.S. equities closed lower across the board on Tuesday, with energy prices climbing again and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield breaking the 5% psychological barrier, heightening market worries about inflation and interest‑rate outlook. Investors are waiting for the Federal Reserve’s rate decision on Wednesday, cooling risk appetite on the market.

All major indexes fell in tandem: the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.8%, the Russell 2000 dropped 0.7%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.6%, and the S&P 500 declined 0.4%. Trading volume on both the Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange rose versus the previous session, reflecting heightened volatility ahead of the Fed’s announcement.

Energy prices were the main source of pressure. New York light crude futures jumped more than 4%, briefly reaching $106.75 a barrel, while natural‑gas futures rose 1.7%. At the same time, the 10‑year Treasury yield rose 5 basis points to 5.01%, putting additional pressure on high‑valuation tech stocks as rates climb.

The Dow closed at 52,093 points, marking the sixth consecutive trading day below its 50‑day moving average and a near‑5% pullback from the August 5 peak of 54,744 points. Both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 also slipped slightly below their respective 50‑day averages, indicating that the recent rally in U.S. stocks is turning into a sideways market.

Market focus shifted to the Fed’s rate decision. According to the original report, most bond traders expect the Fed may raise rates by one quarter point, but the more important signal will come from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at the press conference, including how long the tightening cycle might continue and the Fed’s stance on bringing inflation back to the 2% target.

On the stock‑specific front, selling pressure was broad among Dow components, with financials, technology and consumer stocks bearing the brunt. Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Salesforce (CRM‑US) managed to hold up better, while higher oil prices kept some shipping stocks relatively strong.

items.title: 美國消費韌性背後：加薪與通膨陷入拉鋸戰 而通膨正在勝出
items.title_en: The Resilience of U.S. Consumption: Wage Growth and Inflation in a Tug-of-War, with Inflation Winning
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，物價上漲正在侵蝕一般薪資的購買力。
美國8月平均時薪有所下降，同時消費者物價指數(CPI)的漲幅高於平均時薪的成長幅度。
經過通膨調整後的薪資，即所謂的「實質薪資」，自2月以來一直呈現下降趨勢，目前已略低於2025年5月的水準。2月至8月期間，實質薪資下跌了0.7%。
這次通膨調整後，也就是「實質」薪資下降，很大程度上是受到燃料價格上漲所造成。
雖然這次的降幅不像疫情後那幾年那麼嚴重，但對家庭預算而言，仍代表一次退步。
這也對整體經濟構成風險，因為美國經濟目前越來越依賴股市上漲所帶來的財富效應來支撐消費支出。
由於68%的GDP來自消費支出，如果人們開始縮減家庭預算，以因應食品、汽油等生活必需品價格上漲，經濟成長可能會受到打擊。
勞工購買力下降會削弱消費者信心，如果民眾因此減少消費，也會對整體經濟帶來風險。
Oxford Economics資深經濟學家Bob Schwartz在一篇評論中寫道，「很明顯，今年消費支出的韌性，與其說是受到勞工薪資支撐，不如說更多是來自大量的退稅、消耗存款，以及股市熱度所帶來的財富效應。」
由於目前有相當大一部分的消費支出，是由富裕家庭所帶動，而這些家庭的財務狀況受惠於AI擴張所推動的股市繁榮，因此相較於平常，整體經濟現在對AI產業一旦出現下滑變得更加脆弱。
如果聯準會(Fed)升息，或者社會對AI技術的反彈情緒阻礙資料中心建設，目前支撐股市的這波AI支出熱潮都可能失去動能。
Schwartz寫道，「雖然這些事件發生的可能性不能忽視，但我們並不預期它們會在可預見的未來拖垮整體經濟。然而，很難忽視那些與各種外部衝擊，以及勞工影響力逐漸減弱相關的警訊。」
paras_en: Investopedia reports that rising prices are eroding the purchasing power of ordinary wages.
U.S. average hourly wages fell in August, while the consumer price index (CPI) increased at a faster pace than the growth in average hourly wages.

After adjusting for inflation, the so‑called "real wages" have been on a downward trend since February and are now slightly below the level of May 2025. Between February and August, real wages fell by 0.7%.
The decline in real wages is largely driven by higher fuel prices.
Although the decline is not as severe as in the years following the pandemic, it still represents a setback for household budgets.
This poses a risk to the overall economy because the U.S. economy increasingly relies on the wealth effect from stock market gains to support consumer spending.
Since 68% of GDP comes from consumer spending, if people start cutting household budgets to cope with rising prices for essentials such as food and gasoline, economic growth could be hit.
A decline in labor purchasing power weakens consumer confidence, and if people reduce spending as a result, it poses a risk to the overall economy.

Senior economist Bob Schwartz of Oxford Economics wrote in a commentary that "it is clear that this year’s resilience of consumer spending is less about labor wage support and more about large tax refunds, depletion of savings, and the wealth effect from stock market enthusiasm."

Because a substantial portion of consumer spending is driven by affluent households whose financial positions benefit from the stock market boom fueled by AI expansion, the overall economy is now more vulnerable to a downturn in the AI sector than usual.
If the Fed raises rates or public sentiment against AI technology hampers data center construction, the current AI‑driven spending wave that supports the stock market could lose momentum.

Schwartz wrote that "while the probability of these events cannot be ignored, we do not expect them to collapse the overall economy in the foreseeable future. However, it is difficult to ignore the warning signs associated with various external shocks and the gradual weakening of labor influence."

items.title: 加密貨幣法案闖關美國參議院失敗！比特幣跌超5%創六月來最大跌幅 以太幣崩逾8.3%
paras: 美國《數位資產市場清晰法案》(Clarity Act)周二(15日)在參議院投票未獲得足夠支持，導致推進受阻。受此消息影響，比特幣和以太幣價格應聲大跌，創6月來單日最大跌幅紀錄。
在周二的關鍵程序性投票中，該法案以49票贊成、50票反對的結果，未能達到參議院推進法案所需的60票門檻。
《清晰法案》主要賦予美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)監管數位資產產業的主要權力，並為加密貨幣交易平台，以及現貨交易建立更明確的聯邦監管框架。
該法案的爭議點之一為，增加一項針對美國財政部的「熔斷機制」，允許其禁止加密貨幣企業向穩定幣用戶提供獎勵、利息或收益，這也是數位資產行業與傳統銀行業之間的一個主要爭執。
法案投票失敗的消息迅速傳導至加密貨幣市場，引發大幅拋售，比特幣價格一度下跌5.3%，失守75000美元大關，最低觸及 74910 美元，創6月以來最大跌幅，以太幣跌幅則更重，一度大跌超過8.3%

items.title: 喊話放慢AI腳步引爆川普反彈！Anthropic高層傳會晤美官員 化解安全風險
paras: Anthropic與川普政府因為人工智慧(AI)開發問題關係再度緊張之際，川普政府高階官員周二(15日)與該公司高層主管會面，討論AI的安全風險。
美媒引述知情人士說法報導，已成為Anthropic在華府主要代表的運算長Tom Brown，當天以視訊方式與美國國防部首席技術官Emil Michael及商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)進行會談。

CEO主張放慢AI開發 川普強烈反對

Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)上周六發表一篇3 800字文章，讓該公司與川普政府之間的關係再度緊張。
阿莫戴在文中呼籲政府對AI進行監管，並主張放慢最先進AI系統的開發速度，讓研究人員有更多時間了解潛在威脅。這篇文章很快獲得競爭對手OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)及SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克支持，但美國總統川普卻強烈反彈，把對AI風險的擔憂斥為「騙局」，並反對制定新規範。
Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon上周高調離職，並在社群媒體發布辭職信指責AI公司正在「拿我們的生命冒險」、「AI可能很快毀滅人類」，使先進AI模型的潛在風險在過去一周逐漸成為主流議題。
在川普政府內部，Emil Michael負責五角大廈加速採用AI的工作，他曾公開反駁Coxon所謂AI可能導致全人類死亡的說法。另據知情人士透露，盧特尼克希望在11月期中選舉前，反擊外界對AI技術的負面論述。

Anthropic與美政府關係仍緊張

Anthropic與美國政府的關係已因多項爭議而陷入緊張，例如旗下最先進的Mythos與Fable AI模型因安全問題美國商務部產生分歧，也曾與五角大廈為了AI用於軍事行動一事發生爭執。
Michael曾協助主導Anthropic與美政府有關軍方使用AI技術的談判，但雙方最終談判失敗，原因是五角大廈認為Anthropic提出的條件侵害軍方權限。五角大廈隨後將Anthropic列入黑名單，宣稱該公司對美國供應鏈構成威脅，Anthropic則針對此事對五角大廈提起訴訟，目前案件仍在華府法院進行中。
Brown則是在今年夏初開始受到華府關注，他當時主導與美國官員的高風險談判，爭取解除針對Anthropic最先進AI模型所實施的出口管制。他最終成功完成這項任務，並在本月稍早舉行的科技主題G20峰會上與盧特尼克一同公開露面，當時還特別稱讚川普對資料中心的支持。
Brown如今可能又將面臨另一項棘手挑戰：如何緩解Anthropic與美國官員在AI安全問題上的緊張關係。川普周一在Truth Social發文表示，他的總統任期本身就是AI唯一需要的安全護欄，而且還說，要放慢AI發展是個糟糕的想法，只會讓中國等美國對手受益。

items.title: 台積電2奈米擴大手機版圖 聯發科旗艦晶片天璣9600 Pro最快10月上市
items.title_en: TSMC Expands 2nm Mobile Chip Portfolio; MediaTek's Flagship Dimensity 9600 Pro to Launch as Early as October
paras: 聯發科 (2454-TW) 週二 (15 日) 發表新一代天璣9600系列旗艦5G晶片，其中天璣9600 Pro為聯發科首款採用台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 2奈米製程的手機晶片，鎖定頂規Android市場，搭載新晶片的終端產品最快10月上市。
台積電ADR (TSM-US)週二呈現開高走低，收跌0.96%，至每股 413.99 美元，仍處於季線下方。以台積電原股1股對應ADR 5股計算，ADR收盤價換算約為新台幣2,637.53元，較台股台積電收盤價2,385元溢價252.53元，溢價率10.59%。
繼蘋果A20 Pro之後，聯發科也導入台積電2奈米製程，顯示台積電最新製程正從蘋果生態系進一步擴大至Android旗艦手機市場。
天璣9600 Pro鎖定小米 (1810-HK)、Oppo及Vivo等品牌的高階手機市場，成為聯發科挑戰高通在旗艦Android手機晶片領域地位的重要產品。
聯發科同時推出採用台積電3奈米製程的天璣9600M。兩款晶片分別瞄準不同旗艦市場，9600 Pro將用於Pro、Max及Ultra等頂規機種，9600M則鎖定標準版及Plus等高階產品。
聯發科表示，天璣9600 Pro採用全新AI原生架構，並導入與台積電共同開發的設計技術協同最佳化(DTCO)，讓晶片設計更充分發揮2奈米製程的效能及能源效率。
根據聯發科測試結果，天璣9600 Pro的單核心效能較前代提升17%，多核心效能提高15%，在前代峰值效能下，多核心功耗則減少61%。
在生成式AI方面，新晶片的大型語言模型預填充(prefill)效能提高51%，每瓦權杖生成量提升55%，強化AI模型直接在手機端運作的能力。
不過，上述數據均來自聯發科內部測試，實際表現仍取決於手機品牌的散熱設計、軟體調校及終端產品配置。
聯發科總經理暨營運長陳冠州表示，AI正從雲端延伸至手機、個人電腦及更多終端裝置，公司將整合從邊緣到雲端的技術與生態資源，推動代理式AI(Agentic AI)發展。
聯發科資深副總經理徐敬全指出，天璣9600 Pro是聯發科與台積電首波深度合作的2奈米產品。聯發科不只採用台積電2奈米製程，也透過DTCO進行設計最佳化，進一步提升晶片效能及能源效率。
首批搭載天璣9600系列晶片的手機預計本季上市，其中搭載9600 Pro的終端產品最快10月在台灣亮相。
隨著聯發科加入，台積電2奈米手機晶片客戶版圖進一步擴大。對聯發科而言，天璣9600 Pro則是公司進一步搶攻高階Android手機市場，並縮小與高通差距的重要布局。
不過，先進製程成本上升也可能推高晶片平均售價。聯發科表示，2奈米製造及設計費用增加，加上記憶體價格波動，正為手機品牌帶來終端售價調整壓力。
聯發科將透過降低記憶體占用等技術，減輕零組件成本上升對終端產品的影響。
paras_en: MediaTek (2454-TW) on Tuesday the 15th unveiled its next‑generation Dimensity 9600 series flagship 5G chips, with the Dimensity 9600 Pro becoming MediaTek’s first mobile processor built on TSMC’s (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) 2‑nanometer process, targeting the high‑end Android market and slated to appear in devices as early as October.

TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) traded lower on Tuesday, falling 0.96% to $413.99 per share, still below its weekly moving average. Using the conversion of one TSMC ordinary share to five ADRs, the ADR closing price equates to roughly NT$2,637.53, a premium of NT$252.53 over the TSMC Taiwan‑listed price of NT$2,385, representing a 10.59% premium.
Following Apple’s A20 Pro, MediaTek is also adopting TSMC’s 2‑nm process, indicating that TSMC’s latest node is expanding from the Apple ecosystem into the Android flagship smartphone market.

The Dimensity 9600 Pro is aimed at high‑end phones from brands such as Xiaomi (1810‑HK), Oppo and Vivo, becoming a key product for MediaTek to challenge Qualcomm’s dominance in flagship Android chipsets.

MediaTek also introduced the Dimensity 9600M, built on TSMC’s 3‑nm process. The two chips target different flagship segments: the 9600 Pro for Pro, Max and Ultra‑class devices, and the 9600M for standard and Plus‑class high‑end models.

MediaTek said the Dimensity 9600 Pro uses a brand‑new native AI architecture and incorporates design‑technology co‑optimization (DTCO) jointly developed with TSMC, allowing the chip to fully exploit the performance and energy‑efficiency benefits of the 2‑nm process.

According to MediaTek’s internal tests, the Dimensity 9600 Pro delivers 17% higher single‑core performance and 15% higher multi‑core performance versus its predecessor, while multi‑core power consumption drops 61% at peak performance of the prior generation.

In generative AI workloads, the new chip improves large‑language‑model pre‑fill performance by 51% and raises tokens‑per‑watt generation by 55%, strengthening the ability to run AI models directly on the phone.
However, these figures come from MediaTek’s own testing; real‑world results will still depend on each phone maker’s thermal design, software tuning and device configuration.

MediaTek CEO and COO Chen Kuan‑Chou said AI is moving from the cloud to phones, PCs and more edge devices, and the company will integrate edge‑to‑cloud technologies and ecosystems to drive Agentic AI development.

Senior Vice President Xu Jing‑Chuan noted the Dimensity 9600 Pro is the first wave of deep collaboration between MediaTek and TSMC on a 2‑nm product. MediaTek not only uses the 2‑nm process but also applies DTCO for design optimisation, further boosting chip performance and energy efficiency.
The first batch of phones equipped with Dimensity 9600 series chips is expected to launch this quarter, with devices featuring the 9600 Pro expected to debut in Taiwan as early as October.

With MediaTek’s entry, TSMC’s 2‑nm mobile chip customer base expands further. For MediaTek, the Dimensity 9600 Pro represents a strategic push into the high‑end Android market and a move to narrow the gap with Qualcomm.

Nevertheless, rising costs of advanced processes could lift average chip selling prices. MediaTek said higher 2‑nm manufacturing and design expenses, together with memory price volatility, are putting pressure on handset makers to adjust end‑product pricing.
MediaTek will mitigate the impact of rising component costs on final products by employing techniques such as reducing memory footprint.

items.title: 彭博：中國已完成美國黃豆採購承諾一半目標
items.title_en: Bloomberg: China Has Fulfilled More Than Half of Its U.S. Soybean Purchase Commitment
paras: 據《彭博》14日（周一）報導，知情人士透露，中國已完成年度美國黃豆採購承諾的一半以上，國有貿易商上周至少預訂100萬噸美國黃豆，本季總採購量接近1,300萬噸，超過美方所稱北京承諾到2028年達成2,500萬噸年度目標的一半以上。
美國農業部數據顯示，最近一周美國黃豆裝運量加速至4月以來最高水準，而中國是最大出口目的地。
此外，農業部近日發布的9月報告中調高了黃豆產量和單產預估，出乎分析師此前預期下調的預料。
近期出口激增帶動黃豆價格漲至2023年以來最高水準，為美國農民在收獲季前夕帶來利多。與此同時，美國及其他地區生物燃料摻混比例提高，也增加了對國內加工的需求。
StoneX分析師邁克·卡斯爾在一份報告中表示，這些出口是「一個令人鼓舞的跡象，我們正朝著完成秋季不斷增長的銷售訂單邁進」。
Futures International LLC大宗商品銷售總監喬·戴維斯認為，採購需要持續才能維持這輪漲勢。由於美中兩國在人工智慧競爭等其他問題上的緊張關係，長期貿易前景依然不明朗。
中國買家重返市場，給美國黃豆出口帶來一場久違的反彈。而中國採購能否持續，是未來幾個月美國農民密切關注的關鍵問題。
美國農業網站「FarmProgress」11日報導，隨著中國從7月底開始積極採購美國新季黃豆，美國2026至2027銷售年度的黃豆出口訂單大幅增長。
在川普政府2025年挑起的貿易戰期間，中國曾連續約半年停止採購美國黃豆，轉而大量從巴西進口。去年美國在全球黃豆出口市場的市占率已降至22%，而十年前約40%。

paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Monday the 14th, sources said China has already completed more than half of its annual U.S. soybean purchase commitment, with state‑owned traders booking at least 1 million tonnes of U.S. soybeans last week and total purchases this quarter approaching 13 million tonnes, exceeding the U.S. claim that Beijing pledged to reach half of a 25 million‑ton annual target by 2028.

U.S. Department of Agriculture data show that soybean shipments from the United States accelerated to the highest level since April in the most recent week, with China remaining the largest export destination.
In addition, the USDA’s recent September report raised its forecasts for soybean output and yield, contrary to analysts’ earlier expectations of a downgrade.

The surge in exports has pushed soybean prices to their highest level since 2023, providing a boost to U.S. farmers ahead of the harvest season, while higher bio‑fuel blending ratios in the United States and elsewhere have also increased domestic processing demand.
StoneX analyst Mike Kessel said in a note that these exports are “an encouraging sign, and we are moving toward fulfilling a growing slate of fall sales orders.”

Joe Davis, senior commodity sales director at Futures International LLC, warned that continued purchasing is needed to sustain the current price rally, noting that lingering tensions between the U.S. and China over issues such as AI competition keep the long‑term trade outlook uncertain.

Chinese buyers have returned to the market, delivering a long‑awaited rebound for U.S. soybean exports, and whether Chinese procurement can be sustained will be a key question closely watched by American farmers in the coming months.
FarmProgress reported on the 11th that, as China began actively buying the new U.S. soybean crop at the end of July, export orders for the 2026‑27 marketing year jumped sharply.

During the trade war sparked by the Trump administration in 2025, China halted U.S. soybean purchases for about six months and shifted to large‑scale imports from Brazil; last year the United States’ share of the global soybean export market fell to 22%, down from roughly 40% a decade earlier.

items.title_en: "Tungsten Battle" Rekindles! Overseas‑Domestic Price Gap Exceeds One Million; Domestic Mining Firms' Performance Under China Export Controls Still Unproven
paras: 中國A股鎢相關族群周二(15日)再度衝高，翔鷺鎢業開盤一分鐘內觸及漲停，盤中最大封單超10億元(人民幣，下同)，終場漲9.06%報36.60元；中鎢高新漲5.17%至62.23元，章源鎢業漲5.73%至24.74%至62.23元，章源鎢業漲5.73%至24.74%至62.23元，章源鎢業漲5.73%至24.74元，廈門5.13元，主要因為在海外關鍵礦產政策連續加碼後，市場對鎢供給稀缺性的重新定價。
美國鎢商The Elmet周一(14日)宣布，已獲美國國防部4.5億美元投資，用於緬因、密西根州、俄亥俄等地鎢材產能，當日盤中飆漲約55%。美國商務部上月依據《國防生產法》禁止鎢廢料及電池黑粉出口一年。
與此同時，英國國家財富基金向Tungsten West注資最高7100萬英鎊，重啟德文郡Hemerdon鎢錫礦，目標2027年第一季逐步滿產。
非洲國家辛巴威繼5月將鎢列關鍵礦產後暫停所有形式鎢出口，越南工貿部提議將鎢剔除允許出口清單。
今年1月，中國商務部、海關總署加強對日兩用物項管制，禁止向日本軍事用戶、軍事用途出口。日本財務省數據顯示，今年前7月鎢材進口137.8噸、年減率41.1%，鎢酸鹽進口708.1噸、年減15%。

價格方面，根據中鎢在線周二數據，中國APT報價每噸59萬—60萬元，鎢粉約90萬元、碳化鎢粉約85萬元；歐洲APT報2900-3000美元/噸度(172.2萬—178.2萬人民幣)，較去年初漲價約794%。歐洲鎢鐵每公斤170—180美元(約79.9萬—84.6萬元人民幣)，較去年初漲約298%。中國國內與歐洲同指標噸價相差約112萬—119萬元，但價差不等於國內企業利潤：在出口許可、兩用物項審查、軍用最終用戶限制下，海外高價訂單能否放量，取決於配額、客戶資質與放行節奏。
供給方面，中國占主導，但受總量控制。根據美國USGS統計，去年中國鎢產量6.7萬噸，佔全球78.7%，中國國金證券則稱各方統計均指向今年中國鎢精礦產量將持續年減，海外僅巴庫塔、Sangdong、Dolphin等少數項目形成增量，短期彈性有限。
中國自然資源部每年下達鎢精礦開採總量，2025年首批指標5.8萬噸、年減6.45%，今年進一步降低、低品位礦區指標逐步清零。今年6月，《礦產資源法實施條例》將鎢列入戰略礦產。
根據中國國際礦業大會發布的《中國礦產資源報告2026》，截至「十四五」計畫末年，稀土、鎢、錫等14種礦產儲量居全球第一，但儲量優勢不等於短期可放量。
中鎢在線表示，供需雙方謹慎觀望，交投清淡，等待消費端備庫及下半月大型鎢企長單價；章源9月上半月55%黑鎢精礦長單每噸41.3萬元、白鎢41.2萬元略降。
今年中國APT報價曾由1月每噸約67萬元衝高至3月約152萬元，隨後回撤至9月約59.5萬元，基本抹平年內漲幅，65%黑鎢精礦3月高點約105萬元。硬質合金、PCB微鑽、六氟化鎢構成內需主線，其中六氟化鎢高純粉受中船特氣等半導體、AI氣體鏈關注，但下游以銷量定產量，主動補足庫存。
機構判斷「緊平衡」延續。國金、五礦證券均指出，全球新增鎢礦有限，逆全球化戰略儲備抬升需求，中國國內進口補缺空間受限，中期價格中樞可望上移；華安證券則把AI算力、關鍵礦產焦慮、供給偏緊列為本輪重估三因素。風險在於：中國APT報價若遲遲未脫離59萬—60萬元區間、長單價不上修，股價反彈易受制於業績兌現。此外，出口管制趨嚴雖支撐海外溢價，但也可能限制重量級企業銷售。
對鎢相關類股而言，專家認為後市須看三件事，分別為下半月大廠長單、硬質合金補庫、對日及歐美出口許可放行規模，三者決定「國外高價」能否真正變成中國國內利潤。
paras_en: China A‑share tungsten‑related stocks surged again on Tuesday (the 15th). Within the first minute, Xianglu Tungsten hit its daily limit up, with the largest order book exceeding RMB 1 billion, and closed up 9.06% at RMB 36.60. Zhongtong High‑Tech rose 5.17% to RMB 62.23, and Zhangyuan Tungsten climbed 5.73% to RMB 24.74. The rally was driven by renewed market pricing of tungsten scarcity after overseas key‑minerals policies were repeatedly tightened.

U.S. tungsten producer The Elmet announced on Monday (the 14th) that it had secured a $450 million investment from the U.S. Department of Defense for tungsten capacity in Maine, Michigan and Ohio, sending its shares soaring about 55% intraday. The U.S. Commerce Department last month prohibited the export of tungsten scrap and battery black powder for one year under the Defense Production Act.

At the same time, the UK’s National Wealth Fund pledged up to £71 million to Tungsten West to restart the Hemerdon tungsten‑tin mine in Devon, aiming for gradual full‑capacity production by the first quarter of 2027.

Zimbabwe, which listed tungsten as a critical mineral in May, has temporarily halted all forms of tungsten export, while Vietnam’s Ministry of Industry and Trade has proposed removing tungsten from its list of permitted export commodities.

In January, China’s Ministry of Commerce and General Administration of Customs tightened dual‑use controls, banning exports of tungsten materials to Japanese military users and for military purposes. Japanese Ministry of Finance data show that in the first seven months of this year tungsten imports fell 41.1% year‑on‑year to 137.8 tons, and tungsten salts fell 15% to 708.1 tons.

Pricing: according to Zhongtong Online data on Tuesday, China’s APT price was RMB 590,000‑600,000 per tonne, tungsten powder about RMB 900,000, and carbide‑tungsten powder about RMB 850,000. European APT was $2,900‑3,000 per tonne (RMB 1.722‑1.782 million), up roughly 794% since early last year. European tungsten‑iron fetched $170‑180 per kilogram (about RMB 799,000‑846,000), up about 298% since early last year. The domestic‑European price gap per tonne is roughly RMB 1.12‑1.19 million, but the gap does not equal domestic profit margins: high‑priced overseas orders depend on export licences, dual‑use reviews and end‑user restrictions, as well as quota availability, customer qualifications and clearance speed.

Supply: China remains dominant but production is capped. USGS data show China produced 67,000 tons of tungsten last year, 78.7% of global output. China Guojin Securities says all estimates point to a continued year‑on‑year decline in Chinese tungsten concentrate output this year, with only a few overseas projects such as Baku‑Ta, Sangdong and Dolphin adding incremental supply, leaving little short‑term flexibility.

The Ministry of Natural Resources issues annual tungsten concentrate production quotas; the first batch for 2025 is set at 58,000 tons with a 6.45% annual decline, and this year the quota is further reduced with low‑grade mine targets being phased out. In June, the Implementation Regulations of the Mineral Resources Law added tungsten to the list of strategic minerals.

According to the China Mining Resources Report 2026 released by the China International Mining Conference, by the end of the 14th Five‑Year Plan, China will still hold the world’s largest reserves of 14 minerals including rare earths, tungsten and tin, but reserve size does not guarantee short‑term production capacity.

Zhongtong Online notes that both supply and demand sides are watching cautiously, trading is light, and the market awaits inventory buildup on the consumer side and large‑order pricing from major tungsten firms in the second half of the month. Zhangyuan’s black‑tungsten concentrate long‑order price for the first half of September was RMB 413,000 per ton, slightly down from RMB 412,000 for white tungsten.

China’s APT price rose from about RMB 670,000 per ton in January to roughly RMB 1.52 million in March, then fell back to about RMB 595,000 in September, essentially erasing the intra‑year gain. Black‑tungsten concentrate peaked at about RMB 1.05 million in March (65% of the market). Domestic demand is driven by hard‑metal tools, PCB micro‑drilling and tungsten hexafluoride, with high‑purity WF6 powder attracting semiconductor and AI‑gas players such as CSIC Special Gases, while downstream production is tied to sales volumes, prompting proactive inventory replenishment.

Analysts judge that the “tight‑balance” will continue. Guojin and Wukuang Securities both point out that new global tungsten mines are scarce, and de‑globalisation‑driven strategic stockpiling lifts demand; China’s import gap is limited, so mid‑term price centres could rise. Huian Securities cites AI compute power, critical‑mineral anxiety and tight supply as the three factors driving the current re‑rating. Risks include APT prices lingering in the RMB 590,000‑600,000 band without long‑order price revisions, which could curb stock‑price rebounds if earnings fall short, and stricter export controls that, while supporting overseas premiums, may also limit sales by large firms.

For tungsten‑related equities, experts say the next move hinges on three things: large‑order pricing in the second half of the month, hard‑metal inventory replenishment, and the scale of export licences to Japan and Europe/US. These three will determine whether the “high overseas price” can truly translate into domestic profit.

items.title: 台灣五大ODM重構AI伺服器供應鏈北美在地製造進入加速期
items.title_en: Taiwan's Top Five ODMs Reshape AI Server Supply Chain as North American Local Manufacturing Accelerates
paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器製造加速向北美靠攏，台灣ODM大廠同步擴充美國與墨西哥產能。緯穎(6669-TW)德州El Paso新廠已進入量產，廣達(2382-TW)、鴻海(2317-TW)、仁寶(2324-TW)及英業達(2356-TW)也持續增加美國製造布局，反映雲端服務供應商（CSP）擴大AI資本支出後，供應鏈正從亞洲製造進一步轉向北美在地生產、整櫃測試與就近交付。
緯穎自2025年決議赴美設廠以來，在德州累計投資已超過16億美元，第一棟廠房2026年上半年量產，第二棟預計2027年第2季投產。公司內部預估，2027年美國產能占比將達約20%，並與目前占整體產能約70%的墨西哥基地形成北美「雙子星園區」。
廣達在美國布局超過20年，目前以加州Fremont與田納西Nashville為主要據點，負責AI伺服器L10、L11整櫃最後組裝、通電測試及就近交付。公司2026年資本支出已由新台幣300億元上修至400億元，並對美國子公司增資9.73億美元；預計2026年底前加州再增加3座廠房，全美廠房將超過23座，2026年底AI伺服器產能預計較2025年底倍增。
鴻海同樣加速北美AI伺服器產能布局。公司指出，CSP持續擴大資本支出，帶動AI伺服器機櫃出貨量成長，預期未來一年AI產能需求仍「非常強勁」。目前美國與墨西哥已成為集團AI伺服器主要量產基地，其中美國持續擴充德州、威斯康辛州、俄亥俄州及加州研發與製造量能，墨西哥則扮演鄰近美國客戶的大型製造基地。
鴻海2025年資本支出達新台幣1,738億元，2026年預計再增加逾30%，上半年已投入809億元。墨西哥契瓦瓦州持續擴充AI伺服器產能，2026年5月再增資1.29億美元；美國方面則透過Q-Edge等子公司增加組裝與製造能力，持續強化德州等地布局。
鴻海的北美策略因此不只是增加美國廠房，而是逐步形成「美國在地製造＋墨西哥規模量產」的區域供應架構，貼近美國CSP與大型資料中心客戶。
英業達則以德州作為美國AI伺服器布局核心。德州廠已於2026年第1季底啟用，第2季起機櫃出貨逐步放大，7月再投入5,800萬美元購置Katy廠區東側土地與廠房，加上4,860萬美元電力工程，合計追加1.07億美元，並對北美子公司增資1.1億美元，新產能預計2027年進一步到位。
英業達的布局也反映北美製造不只聚焦單一L11整櫃。公司2026年下半年AI伺服器出貨仍以L6主機板為大宗，同時德州廠已取得北美CSP客戶L10 ASIC伺服器訂單，顯示台廠正依客戶需求，把L6主機板、L10系統到L11機櫃等不同製造環節逐步移往北美。
仁寶也加入美國擴產行列。台灣大溪AI伺服器製造中心預計2026年第4季開始貢獻營收，新增L10伺服器與L11整櫃製造能力，AI伺服器系統產能預計增加一倍；美國德州基地則規劃2027年全面拉升產能。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – AI server manufacturing is rapidly shifting toward North America, and Taiwan's major ODMs are simultaneously expanding capacity in the United States and Mexico. Wiwin (6669‑TW) has begun mass production at its new plant in El Paso, Texas, while Quanta (2382‑TW), Foxconn (2317‑TW), Compal (2324‑TW) and Inventec (2356‑TW) continue to increase their U.S. manufacturing footprint, reflecting that cloud service providers (CSPs) are boosting AI capex and the supply chain is moving from Asian production to on‑site North American assembly, testing and delivery.

Since deciding in 2025 to build a plant in the United States, Wiwin has invested more than US$1.6 billion in Texas. The first factory entered mass production in the first half of 2026, and a second building is slated for Q2 2027. The company estimates that by 2027 U.S. capacity will account for about 20% of its output, complementing its Mexico base, which currently provides roughly 70% of total capacity, forming a North American “twin‑park” arrangement.

Quanta has been operating in the United States for over 20 years, with its main sites in Fremont, California and Nashville, Tennessee, handling final assembly, power‑up testing and local delivery of AI server L10 and L11 full‑rack units. Its 2026 capital expenditure was raised from NT$30 billion to NT$40 billion, and it injected US$973 million into its U.S. subsidiaries. Quanta plans to add three more factories in California by the end of 2026, bringing its total U.S. sites to more than 23, and expects AI server capacity at year‑end to double versus the end of 2025.

Foxconn is also accelerating its North American AI server capacity rollout. The company notes that CSPs’ continued capex expansion is driving growth in AI server rack shipments, and it expects AI capacity demand to remain “very strong” over the next year. The United States and Mexico have become the group’s primary mass‑production hubs, with the U.S. expanding R&D and manufacturing in Texas, Wisconsin, Ohio and California, while Mexico serves as a large‑scale manufacturing base close to U.S. customers.

Foxconn’s 2025 capital expenditure reached NT$173.8 billion, and it plans to increase spending by more than 30% in 2026, having already invested NT$80.9 billion in the first half of the year. In Mexico’s Chiapas state, AI server capacity is being expanded with an additional US$129 million investment in May 2026; in the United States, subsidiaries such as Q‑Edge are boosting assembly and manufacturing capabilities, further strengthening the Texas footprint.

Thus, Foxconn’s North American strategy is not merely adding U.S. factories but gradually creating a regional supply structure of “local U.S. manufacturing plus large‑scale production in Mexico,” positioning the company close to U.S. CSPs and major data‑center customers.

Inventec is centering its U.S. AI server layout around Texas. Its Texas plant was commissioned at the end of Q1 2026, and rack shipments began scaling up in Q2. In July, Inventec invested US$58 million to acquire land and facilities on the east side of its Katy campus, plus US$48.6 million for power infrastructure—a total of US$107 million—and injected US$110 million into its North American subsidiary. The new capacity is expected to come online in 2027.

Inventec’s plan also shows that North American manufacturing is not limited to a single L11 full‑rack. In the second half of 2026, the company’s AI server shipments will still be dominated by L6 motherboards, while the Texas plant has already secured an order from a North American CSP for L10 ASIC servers, indicating that Taiwanese firms are moving L6 boards, L10 systems and L11 racks to North America in line with customer demand.

Compal is also joining the U.S. expansion. Its Da‑xi AI server manufacturing center in Taiwan is slated to start contributing revenue in Q4 2026, adding L10 servers and L11 full‑rack capacity and doubling AI server system output. The Texas base in the United States is planned to ramp up capacity fully in 2027.

items.title: 美光推全球首款512GB DDR5記憶體模組 預計2027下半年量產
items.title_en: Micron Announces World’s First 512GB DDR5 Memory Module, Plans Mass Production in Late 2027
paras: 美光 (MU-US) 在超高密度伺服器記憶體領域取得新進展，已成功在多款伺服器平台展示全球首款512GB DDR5 RDIMM，並預計於 2027 年下半年依客戶需求投入量產。
美光 (MU-US) 週二股價收漲0.39%，上漲3.57美元，收在每股927.60美元。盤中最高觸及944.94美元，最低下探920.13美元。
美光表示，這款512GB DDR5模組是公司產品開發的重要里程碑，鎖定人工智慧 (AI)、資料分析、記憶體內資料庫及模擬運算等高負載應用，傳輸速度最高可達9,200 MT/s。
AMD (AMD-US) 與英特爾 (INTC-US) 目前均在驗證這款模組，以確認其與下一代伺服器平台的相容性，並為後續部署與量產做好準備。
美光透過先進垂直互連封裝技術，利用矽穿孔 (TSV) 垂直堆疊並連接DRAM晶粒，在維持資料中心所需效能的同時，提高單一封裝的記憶體密度。
若搭載於具有24個記憶體插槽的雙路伺服器，整體DDR5記憶體容量最高可達12TB，讓更多資料直接留在主記憶體內，降低對速度較慢儲存設備的依賴及資料搬移成本。
在能源效率方面，單一512GB RDIMM的運作功耗，較4條128GB RDIMM組成的同容量配置降低逾60%，可在不擴大現有伺服器空間的情況下，提高記憶體容量、虛擬化密度及能源效率。
美光雲端記憶體事業部資深副總裁暨總經理Raj Narasimhan表示，512GB RDIMM能支援多TB級伺服器，滿足更大型的AI與資料庫工作負載，同時改善資源利用率。
效能測試顯示，在以Spark支援向量機 (SVM) 為基礎的記憶體受限型資料分析工作負載中，512GB RDIMM效能最高可達256GB DDR5配置的1.4倍。
新模組也適用於RocksDB、Redis等高度依賴記憶體的資料庫及快取平台，可提高資料處理量與並行作業能力，並支援更大規模的資料集。
美光指出，隨著大型語言模型 (LLM)、代理型AI、即時推論及高核心數CPU工作負載快速成長，市場對伺服器記憶體容量、頻寬及能源效率的需求持續升高。
AMD表示，正與美光合作整合運算與記憶體創新，以因應現代資料中心工作負載日益增加的規模與複雜度。英特爾也指出，記憶體容量與頻寬正成為影響伺服器整體效能的重要因素。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) has made a new breakthrough in ultra‑high‑density server memory, successfully demonstrating the world’s first 512GB DDR5 RDIMM on multiple server platforms and expects to begin volume production in the second half of 2027 based on customer demand.
Micron’s shares closed up 0.39% on Tuesday, rising $3.57 to $927.60 per share, with intraday highs of $944.94 and lows of $920.13.

Micron said the 512GB DDR5 module is a major product‑development milestone, targeting high‑load workloads such as artificial intelligence (AI), data analytics, in‑memory databases and simulation computing, with transfer speeds up to 9,200 MT/s.
AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) are currently validating the module to confirm compatibility with next‑generation server platforms and to prepare for subsequent deployment and mass production.

Micron uses advanced vertical interconnect packaging technology, employing silicon‑through‑via (TSV) vertical stacking and bonding of DRAM dies, which boosts memory density per package while maintaining the performance required by data centers.

When installed in a dual‑socket server with 24 memory slots, the total DDR5 memory capacity can reach up to 12 TB, allowing more data to stay directly in main memory, reducing reliance on slower storage and lowering data‑movement costs.

In terms of energy efficiency, a single 512GB RDIMM consumes over 60% less power than an equivalent capacity configuration built from four 128GB RDIMMs, enabling higher memory capacity, virtualization density and energy efficiency without expanding existing server space.

Raj Narasimhan, senior vice president and general manager of Micron’s Cloud Memory Business, said the 512GB RDIMM can support multi‑TB servers, meeting larger AI and database workloads while improving resource utilization.

Performance tests showed that for memory‑constrained data‑analytics workloads based on Spark‑supported support vector machines (SVM), the 512GB RDIMM delivers up to 1.4 times the performance of a 256GB DDR5 configuration.
The new module is also suitable for memory‑intensive databases and caching platforms such as RocksDB and Redis, increasing data throughput and parallelism and supporting larger data sets.

Micron noted that as large language models (LLM), agent‑based AI, real‑time inference and high‑core‑count CPU workloads grow rapidly, demand for server memory capacity, bandwidth and energy efficiency continues to rise.

AMD said it is working with Micron to integrate compute and memory innovations to meet the increasing scale and complexity of modern data‑center workloads, and Intel also highlighted that memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming key factors affecting overall server performance.

items.title: 投資人主動送錢！OpenAI傳洽談新募資 估值衝上1.2兆美元大增41%
items.title_en: Investors Take the Initiative! OpenAI Said to Discuss New Funding Round, Valuation Jumps 41% to $1.2 Trillion
paras: 英國《金融時報》(FT)周二(15日)引述知情人士說法報導，OpenAI近期已與大型投資人討論新一輪募資，將使這家ChatGPT開發商在上市前的估值提高至約1.2兆美元。

投資人主動接洽 募資討論仍處早期

根據報導，OpenAI與投資人的接觸還在初步階段，1.2兆美元的估值未來幾個月仍可能改變。值得注意的是，有關募資的討論是由投資人主動發起，而非OpenAI主動尋求。
OpenAI今年3月才完成最近期一輪募資，當時獲得1220億美元承諾資金，估值達8520億美元。
若以1.2兆美元估值計算，較3月那一輪募資時的8520億美元估值高出約41%。

2026年不上市 AI風險成焦點

OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)上周六證實，OpenAI今年不會上市，以優先考量人工智慧(AI)發展風險。
界對AI的安全性及遭濫用的疑慮持續升高之際，OpenAI與競爭對手Anthropic近日都呼籲加強AI監管。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)上周六發表一篇3800字文章，文中呼籲政府對AI進行監管，並主張放慢最先進AI系統的開發速度，讓研究人員有更多時間了解潛在威脅。這篇文章很快獲得OpenAI的奧特曼及SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克支持，但美國總統川普卻強烈反彈，把對AI風險的擔憂斥為「騙局」，並反對制定新規範。
而據路透本月稍早報導，Anthropic最快預定10月中旬開始推銷首次公開發行(IPO)，擬於11月美國期中選舉前幾天完成上市。
paras_en: The Financial Times (FT) in the UK reported on Tuesday (the 15th) that, according to sources, OpenAI has recently been in talks with large investors about a new funding round that would lift the ChatGPT developer’s pre‑IPO valuation to roughly $1.2 trillion.

Investor‑initiated talks are still in the early stage, and the $1.2 trillion valuation could still change over the next few months. Notably, the fundraising discussion was sparked by investors rather than by OpenAI itself.
OpenAI only completed its most recent financing in March of this year, when it secured $122 billion in committed capital and was valued at $852 billion.
Using the $1.2 trillion figure, the valuation is about 41% higher than the $852 billion valuation from the March round.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed last Saturday that the company will not go public this year, prioritising the risks associated with artificial‑intelligence development.
As concerns over AI safety and misuse continue to rise, both OpenAI and rival Anthropic have recently called for stronger AI regulation.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a 3,800‑word essay last Saturday urging governments to regulate AI and to slow the development of the most advanced systems so researchers have more time to understand potential threats. The piece quickly drew support from OpenAI’s Altman and SpaceX AI chief Elon Musk, while former U.S. President Trump reacted strongly, dismissing AI‑risk worries as a "scam" and opposing new rules.

According to a Reuters report earlier this month, Anthropic plans to begin marketing its initial public offering as early as mid‑October, aiming to complete the listing a few days before the U.S. midterm elections in November.

items.title_en: Applied Materials Deepens Indian Semiconductor Footprint with $375 Million Expansion of Manufacturing and R&D Base
paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球半導體設備供應鏈持續擴大印度布局，美國半導體設備大廠應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)計畫未來10年在印度卡納塔卡邦投資360億盧比（約3.75億美元），投資範圍涵蓋研發、半導體設備製造，以及晶片生產所需軟體技術，進一步擴大印度在全球半導體設備供應鏈的角色。
卡納塔卡邦工業部長MB Patil表示，應用材料已與邦政府簽署合作備忘錄，新計畫將落腳於班加羅爾Kempegowda國際機場附近的Signature Business Park，預計創造約1,000個工作機會，並成為該園區首個進駐的工業項目。
土地布局已先行啟動。卡納塔卡邦內閣今年4月批准，以租購方式提供應用材料140英畝土地，交易金額為78億盧比，每平方英尺土地估值1,288盧比，最終配置仍須取得相關監管許可。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – The global semiconductor equipment supply chain continues to expand its presence in India. U.S. semiconductor equipment giant Applied Materials (AMAT-US) plans to invest 36 billion rupees (about $375 million) in Karnataka over the next ten years. The investment will cover research and development, semiconductor equipment manufacturing, and software technology needed for chip production, further enlarging India’s role in the worldwide semiconductor equipment supply chain.

Karnataka’s Industry Minister MB Patil said Applied Materials has signed a memorandum of understanding with the state government. The new project will be located at Signature Business Park near Bangalore’s Kempegowda International Airport and is expected to create roughly 1,000 jobs, becoming the first industrial project to move into the park.

Land acquisition has already begun. The Karnataka cabinet approved in April this year a lease‑purchase arrangement to provide Applied Materials with 140 acres of land, valued at 7.8 billion rupees, at an estimated price of 1,288 rupees per square foot. Final deployment will still require the necessary regulatory approvals.

Applied Materials has been operating in India for about 20 years and has developed Bangalore into a key operational hub. This investment not only continues the existing R&D footprint but also adds semiconductor equipment manufacturing, showing the company’s shift in India from a research and talent base toward a more complete semiconductor equipment supply chain that includes manufacturing and software development.

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – U.S. equities closed lower across the board on Tuesday, with energy prices climbing again and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield breaking the 5% psychological barrier, heightening market worries about inflation and interest‑rate outlook. Investors are waiting for the Federal Reserve’s rate decision on Wednesday, cooling risk appetite on the market.

All major indexes fell in tandem: the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.8%, the Russell 2000 dropped 0.7%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.6%, and the S&P 500 declined 0.4%. Both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 also slipped slightly below their respective 50‑day averages, indicating that the recent rally in U.S. stocks is turning into a sideways market.

Market focus shifted to the Fed’s rate decision. According to the original report, most bond traders expect the Fed may raise rates by one quarter point, but the more important signal will come from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at the press conference, including how long the tightening cycle might continue and the Fed’s stance on bringing inflation back to the 2% target.

On the stock‑specific front, selling pressure was broad among Dow components, with financials, technology and consumer stocks bearing the brunt. Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Salesforce (CRM‑US) managed to hold up better, while higher oil prices kept some shipping stocks relatively strong.
